goal: Prevent BIP 157 light clients from disconnecting or banning nodes when requesting new block filters
Defer serving filter requests for known blocks until the filter index catches up instead of dropping them
agreement: Support for deferring racing filter requests in net processing to avoid disconnects (ajtowns, mzumsande)
Approves the peer-pausing design with suggestions on request timeouts and retry timers (ajtowns)
Prior objections to touching index internals were resolved by keeping logic in P2P code (sedited, mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes an interoperability bug where light clients disconnect or ban Core nodes
Clients interpret non-response for an advertised block as protocol misbehavior
Resolves recurring connection drops seen by Neutrino and other light client wallets
